feature_blinding: Only archive metadata and source TSV annotations were inspected when this protocol was registered; no selected WAV samples or derived audio features were inspected.

source.identity_evidence: individually leg-ringed captive rooks; one observer annotated the emitter
source.recording_context: all focal birds housed together in one outdoor aviary

sample.channel_policy: one fixed channel for both source recordings; no multichannel features
sample.padding: labelled call plus margin, centred in zero-valued padding
sample.overlap_policy: reject a candidate when any differently labelled, Inc, or Pls annotation overlaps its extracted signal interval

nuisance.name: duration_only
nuisance.features: annotated signal duration including the fixed margin

nuisance.name: level_only
nuisance.features: signal-window log RMS dBFS, peak dBFS, and crest factor; zero padding excluded

head.name: dual_ridge
head.feature_processing: representation-specific enrollment-only normalization followed by enrollment-mean centering

gate.context_match: one exact Event value, one source recording per split, and every identity represented in both recordings
gate.identity_signal: primary accuracy permutation p <= 0.05 and identity-block bootstrap lower bound > 0.2
gate.incremental_signal: paired identity-block bootstrap lower bound for primary minus each nuisance accuracy > 0
gate.pass: the primary representation satisfies context_match, identity_signal, nuisance_screen, and incremental_signal
gate.stop: If the primary representation fails, do not use this sample for SSL, mixture, OT, or later model comparisons. A pass retains the unresolved within-category micro-position limitation and counts as one species-level G1 benchmark, not evidence for Djuma identity or abundance.

claim_limit: This is a captive, closed-set, exact-event sensitivity benchmark. Shared recordings and simple duration/level controls defeat known coarse shortcuts but cannot eliminate stable within-category micro-position or aviary acoustics, and the result does not establish open-set Djuma re-identification.
publication_note: Template only: populate identities locally from the cited publisher annotations. Do not treat this as the frozen original protocol.
